scope: Proposition 5.5 (Common readouts) of the manuscript “Critical Center Magnetization in the Planar XY Model” (preprints/Critical-Center-Magnetization-in-the-Planar-XY-Model-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8347485745eaf583), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
